alt: A three-row table of runner name, time and bib number, first in input order, then with a tied pair of times highlighted, then rearranged ascending by the tuple (time, bib), fastest first.

steps.caption: Each runner's key is the tuple (time, bib), read in the order the input lists them.
Two runners share the same time, so the first key alone cannot rank them.
The tuple's second element, bib number, breaks the tie: sorted() compares it only when the first elements are equal.
sorted() rearranges the runners by (time, bib), ascending: the fastest time first.
Each runner's key is the tuple (time, bib), read in the order the input lists them.
Every time is distinct here, so the tuple's second element, bib, never needs to break a tie.
sorted() rearranges the runners by (time, bib), ascending: the fastest time first.
